Examples.Title: Initiate a web crawl from a base URL
Examples.Description: Tavily Crawl is a graph-based website traversal tool that can explore hundreds of paths in parallel with built-in extraction and intelligent discovery.
Examples.Code:
### Initiate a web crawl from a base URL
# @name crawl
POST {{host}}/crawl
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{
  "url": "docs.tavily.com",
  "instructions": "Find all pages about the Python SDK",
  "chunks_per_source": 3,
  "max_depth": 1,
  "max_breadth": 20,
  "limit": 50,
  "select_paths": "openapi-json-null-sentinel-value-2BF93600-0FE4-4250-987A-E5DDB203E464",
  "select_domains": "openapi-json-null-sentinel-value-2BF93600-0FE4-4250-987A-E5DDB203E464",
  "exclude_paths": "openapi-json-null-sentinel-value-2BF93600-0FE4-4250-987A-E5DDB203E464",
  "exclude_domains": "openapi-json-null-sentinel-value-2BF93600-0FE4-4250-987A-E5DDB203E464",
  "allow_external": true,
  "include_images": false,
  "extract_depth": "basic",
  "format": "markdown",
  "include_favicon": false,
  "timeout": 150,
  "include_usage": false
}

## Responses
# 200
# Description: Crawl results returned successfully
# Content-Type: application/json
# 400
# Description: Bad Request - Your request is invalid.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 401
# Description: Unauthorized - Your API key is wrong or missing.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 403
# Description: Forbidden - URL is not supported.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 429
# Description: Too Many Requests. Error messages and retry delays can vary by rate-limit rule.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 432
# Description: Key limit or Plan Limit exceeded
# Content-Type: application/json
# 433
# Description: PayGo limit exceeded
# Content-Type: application/json
# 500
# Description: Internal Server Error - We had a problem with our server.
# Content-Type: application/json

Examples.Title: Retrieve raw web content from specified URLs
Examples.Description: Extract content from one URL or batch up to 20 URLs in one request. Successful URLs appear in results; per-URL failures appear in failed_results. Check both arrays even when the response is HTTP 200. Request options apply to every URL in the batch.
Examples.Code:
### Retrieve raw web content from specified URLs
# @name extract
POST {{host}}/extract
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{
  "urls": "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Artificial_intelligence",
  "query": "string",
  "chunks_per_source": 3,
  "extract_depth": "basic",
  "include_images": false,
  "include_favicon": false,
  "format": "markdown",
  "timeout": "None",
  "include_usage": false
}

## Responses
# 200
# Description: Extraction completed. Check results and failed_results for each URL. HTTP 200 can have an empty results array when all valid URLs fail during extraction; output order is not guaranteed.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 400
# Description: Bad Request. More than 20 URLs, an empty URL list, or no URLs passing validation are rejected. When all URLs fail validation, detail.failed_results describes the individual failures.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 401
# Description: Unauthorized - Your API key is wrong or missing.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 429
# Description: Too Many Requests. Error messages and retry delays can vary by rate-limit rule.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 432
# Description: Key limit or Plan Limit exceeded
# Content-Type: application/json
# 433
# Description: PayGo limit exceeded
# Content-Type: application/json
# 500
# Description: Internal Server Error - We had a problem with our server.
# Content-Type: application/json

Examples.Title: Submit feedback on a search request or session
Examples.Description: Submit feedback on how relevant and useful Tavily's results were for your task.
Examples.Code:
### Submit feedback on a search request or session
POST {{host}}/feedback
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{
  "request_id": "8442d8d0-8b74-4fca-a89e-5b1b6dd33295",
  "session_id": "5874812a-2e9b-43ea-8978-6cc9225b587b",
  "agent_score": 1,
  "human_score": 1,
  "extra_scores": [
    {
      "label": "freshness",
      "value": 0.4
    },
    {
      "label": "authority",
      "value": 0.9
    }
  ],
  "comment": "Results were authoritative but several were more than a year old.",
  "response_delivered": "Lionel Messi is an Argentine footballer born in 1987...",
  "used_ids": [
    "a3f9c2-04",
    "a3f9c2-07"
  ],
  "used_urls": [
    "https://www.britannica.com/facts/Lionel-Messi"
  ],
  "used_citations": [
    "Messi is known for his exceptional dribbling skills, vision, and goal-scoring ability."
  ],
  "urls_scores": [
    {
      "id": "a3f9c2-04",
      "agent_score": 1,
      "comment": "Directly answered the question."
    },
    {
      "url": "https://example.com/stale-page",
      "agent_score": -1,
      "scores": [
        {
          "label": "freshness",
          "value": 0.1
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

## Responses
# 200
# Description: Feedback accepted
# Content-Type: application/json
# 400
# Description: Bad Request — neither `session_id` nor `request_id` was provided, or a `urls_scores` item is missing both `id` and `url`.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 401
# Description: Unauthorized - Your API key is wrong or missing.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 413
# Description: Payload Too Large — the request body exceeds 256 KB.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 422
# Description: Unprocessable Entity — a field failed validation (e.g. a list or string exceeds its maximum length).
# Content-Type: application/json
# 500
# Description: Internal Server Error
# Content-Type: application/json

Examples.Title: Get organization usage across all API keys
Examples.Description:
Retrieve usage (credits), pay-as-you-go USD cost, and request counts for **every API key under an organization you own**, mirroring the platform's Usage analytics page.

Identify the organization by **name** in the request body. Authenticate with the organization owner's **personal API key** — the key from the owner's own personal account, **not** an organization or enterprise API key. Supports date-range, project, and depth filtering.
Examples.Code:
### Get organization usage across all API keys
POST {{host}}/org-usage
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{
  "organization_name": "Acme Inc",
  "start_date": "2026-05-01",
  "end_date": "2026-05-27",
  "project_id": "string",
  "depth": "advanced"
}

## Responses
# 200
# Description: Organization usage returned successfully
# Content-Type: application/json
# 400
# Description: Invalid start_date; expected format YYYY-MM-DD.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 401
# Description: Unauthorized: missing or invalid API key.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 403
# Description: Please authenticate with the organization owner's personal API key, not an organization API key.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 404
# Description: Organization not found or access denied.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 422
# Description: organization_name is required.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 429
# Description: Too many requests - Rate limit exceeded
# Content-Type: application/json
# 500
# Description: Internal server error
# Content-Type: application/json
# 504
# Description: Gateway timeout - the usage lookup took too long
# Content-Type: application/json
